posts.author: Yaoi
posts.body:
Hi, I’m using RPG Maker MZ with the MZ 3D plugin. I’m trying to combine and vertically stack three separate tiles into one cohesive tile in 3D view. They currently combine along the ground, but I need it to be one tile on the ground and two tiles stacked vertically above it. This is the code I’m using—can anyone suggest what I might be doing wrong?
<mz3d>
E,1,22: shape(custom); sprite3d(0,0,0,E,1,24); sprite3d(0,1,0,E,1,23); sprite3d(0,2,0,E,1,22)
E,1,23: shape(none)
E,1,24: shape(none)
</mz3d>
